Commentary.Commentary: That is it from today's game. Namibia have sealed their place in the next stage of the qualifiers but we still do not know who will be the remaining teams to join them. So far, Papua New Guinea and Netherlands have qualified from group A along with Namibia, while Ireland and Oman have qualified from group B. Join us on Sunday as Papua New Guinea takes on Kenya at 1000 Local (0600 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

Amjad Mahmood, the Singapore skipper, says that they started well but credits Gerhard Erasmus who played a superb innings and took the game away. Points out that three dropped catches did not help them and believes they will work hard. Further says that he did not mind chasing on this wicket. Mentions that his side played good cricket throughout the tournament and are taking back a lot of positives. Ends by saying that they have a few quick bowlers back in Singapore who are quite good.

Namibia skipper, Gerhard Erasmus, gets the Man of the Match award for his superb half ton. On his back-to-back half tons, Erasmus says that as a leader of the side he needed to step up and he is happy he did that. Adds that if the batters can get the timing right, the longer boundary should not be an issue. On the over where he hit 4 consecutive sixes, Erasmus says that he was happy to hit those runs from the middle of the bat. Adds that the entire batting has not fired together yet but they are not worried about it and will stay calm. On the bowlers, Erasmus mentions that the bowlers are skillful and if they can bowl on good lines and lengths, they can dismiss any batters in the world. Going into the next phase of the tournament, the skipper hopes that maybe the senior pros of the side can turn up in these pressure games and help the side win. On the dropped catches, Erasmus mentions that things like this happen. Adds that they have held onto quite a few good catches in the tournament so they can't term this as a weakness.

Earlier in the day, it was the Gerhard Erasmus show. He played aggressively throughout his knock of 72 runs off 46 balls. The other Namibian batters supported him throughout his innings as they played around him and helped their team post a huge score of 191 runs on the board. None of the bowlers showed any stomach for Singapore except their skipper Amjad Mahboob who took a 3-fer.

As for Namibia, they carried on the work that their batters did in the first innings as they destroyed the Singapore team. Jan Frylinck was top-notch throughout his spell as he took a 4-fer and bowled very good lines and lengths. He was ably supported by all his bowlers but Christi Viljoen is the one who stood out as he too took a 3-fer and finished off the innings.

Right from the word go, the Namibian bowlers were on top of the Singapore batters. No one except for Navin Param crossed even the 20-run mark for Singapore and it never looked like they would chase down this huge total set by the Namibia team.
Namibia have sailed through to a victory here over Singapore as they have defeated them by 87 runs! They move onto third place in their group which means that they have qualified to the next stage.

OUT! Bowled! Game over! A massive win for Namibia. Viljoen bowls a slow full toss on the stumps, Param goes for the heave but misses it altogether. The ball goes behind to shatter the stumps. NAMIBIA WIN BY 87 RUNS AND QUALIFY FOR THE NEXT ROUND.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Good length ball around off, Mahboob guides it towards third man but denies a single there.
Full toss outside off, Param looks to pull but gets a leading edge towards cover. A single taken.
FOUR! Outside and a boundary now. 100 up for Singapore. Full ball outside off, Param goes for an expansive drive but manages a thick outside edge which races to the third man fence.
Good length ball around middle and leg, Navin goes for the slog but misses because of the slowness of the delivery. A stifled appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Full outside off, Param drives it through mid off for a single.
JJ Smit comes back on. 2-0-17-1 are his figures so far.
Length ball on the pads, Mahboob looks to work it down the leg side but he is hit on the pads.
Yorker now. Mahboob does well to keep it out.

DROPPED! Don't remember how many catches have been dropped by the fielders in this game. Full ball outside off, Navin looks to loft it over the mid off fielder. He cannot make a proper connection. The mid off fielder moves to his left to catch but spills out the chance.
WIDE! Another bumper, aiming the head of the batter. Param somehow sways himself away. Called wide by the umpire.
Shortish length ball on the body, Mahboob hops to push it towards point for a run.
Amjad Mahboob the skipper is the last man to come out to bat.

OUT! Number 9 goes down. Namibia are all smiles. A super catch from the keeper diving to his left. Golden duck for Baskaran. Good length ball, angling away from the left-hander. Baskaran looks to guide it towards the third man region but manages to get just an  outside edge on it. The ball goes to the left of the keeper, Green who dives and holds onto the ball.
Length ball on the middle, Param tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Vinoth Baskaran is the new man in. Christi Viljoen comes back on. 2-0-10-1 are his figures so far.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sidhant departs! Frylinck bowls a full length ball way outside off, Sidhant looks to chase after it. He swipes at this ball but the ball goes off the bottom edge towards Green who takes a good low catch. The umpire took some time before raising his finger as he confirmed with the leg umpire that the ball has carried. Singapore 8 down now and waiting for Namibia to put them out of their misery.
SIX! Length ball on middle and leg, Sidhant rocks back and heaves this one over the deep mid-wicket fielder for a biggie.
Singh pushes this full ball towards cover.
Param drives this fuller length ball through mid on for a single.
Length ball on middle, Sidhant pull this one towards long on and takes one.
Sidhant pushes this one towards the man at mid off.
Wide! Way outside off, Sidhant looks to have a swipe at it but misses. Wided!
On the pads of Param, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Singh pushes this one off the back foot towards long on for one.
Shortish in length, Param pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Full toss on the pads, Sidhant Singh pushes it through mid on for a single.
Param again gets down on one knee but this time he sweeps it towards backward square leg for one.
FOUR! Param this time gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Play and a miss now! Length ball outside off, Sidhant goes for a heave but misses.
Another full toss outside off, Navin looks to drive it over the covers but mistimes, the ball goes towards cover-point uppishly for a run.
Full toss outside off, eased through covers for a run this time.
Good length ball outside off, pushed through point and short third man for a couple.
Sidhant Singh is the next man in for Singapore.

OUT! CAUGHT! Prakash holes out! Frylinck bowls one outside off, Janak looking to go over the cover-point region could only manage it to squeeze it straight to point. Kotze there grabs an easy sitter. Singapore in dire straits with 7 down.
Fuller length ball way outside off, Param squeezes it to point for as single.
Jan Frylinck is back into the attack. Two wickets in his first over for him.
On the pads, Param gets down on one knee and sweeps this one towards backward square leg for one.
This time Prakash pushes this through mid on for a single.
Floated on middle and off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length this time, Param pushes it off the back foot towards long off for one.
Floated outside off again, Param drives this one towards deep cover. The fielder in the deep dives and saves a couple of runs for his side. Good fielding this.
Floated on off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
Length and outside off, Prakash runs it down to third man for a single.
Short one on off,  Prakash looks to pull it towards the mid-wicket but gets a top edge over the keeper towards fine leg fence. The batsmen take a couple.
Length and outside off, Param drives it to covers for a single.
On a length and outside off, Param leaves it alone.
A low full toss outside off, Prakash plays  it to long on  for a single.
Length and on off, Prakash slashes it over point for a couple.
On the pads, Prakash flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Param pushes this one through mid off and takes another single.
Param gets down on one knee and plays the reverse sweep. The ball goes straight towards the fielder at gully.
Prakash drives this floated one through mid off for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, Param plays the paddle sweep and the ball goes towards fine leg for a single.
Floated just outside off, the ball pitches and turns away. The batter looks to flick but is beaten.
Yorker! A good one too. Prakash gets his bat down in time to dig it out.
Another bumper around off, Prakash sways away.
Another short of a length ball around off, tapped towards point for a run.
Janak Prakash comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Manpreet holes out! A shortish length ball outside off, Manpreet goes for the pull shot but gets a top edge. The ball goes high and finds Shikongo at deep square leg. Wicket no. 6 and the game is going out of reach of Singapore now.
On middle this time, Param flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good length ball on stumps, tucked towards point.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
Manpreet Singh flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a couple.
On the pads of Param, he flicks this one towards square leg for a single. He is off the mark with this.
Navin Param is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Zane Green is quick to whip the bails off and David has to walk back. David looks to up the ante as he comes down the track. Scholtz spots this and pushes a flatter delivery. David misses his flick due to the change in pace and Green whips the bails off with David way outside the crease. Half the side back in the hut for Singapore!
This time outside off, Singh pushes this one towards backward point for a single.
Flatter on the pads, the batter pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bernard Scholtz to bowl now.
Again MS is beaten as he misses his cut shot to this length ball. End of over 7 and Singapore need 145 runs from 78 balls.
Fuller in length this time, Singh looks to push it towards cover for a single but is beaten as the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Length ball way wide outside off, Manpreet Singh goes chasing after it but misses his cut shot.
David connects this time and the ball goes towards long on for one.
Length ball wide outside off, David looks to smash it down the ground but misses the ball completely.
Williams starts with a length ball around middle, Manpreet works it behind square leg for a single.
Craig Williams is into the attack.
Good length ball around off, pushed towards covers for a single. 45 for 4 in the Powerplay.
Full ball on the pads, eased through mid on for a single. Not good use of the free hit.
Free Hit time!
NO BALL! It has been called no ball for the height. Short ball down the leg side, David looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Hammered! Good length ball on off and middle, David makes room by moving towards the leg side and creams his drive through cover-point.
Another shortish ball, worked on the leg side by Manpreet for a quick run.
Shortish ball outside off, David punches it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Starts with a shortish length ball on the body, tucked behind square for a couple of runs.
Manpreet Singh is in now with his side reeling at 34 for 4. Ben Shikongo to bowl the last over of the Powerplay.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stephan Baard takes the catch and Rangarajan departs! Fuller one on the pads, Rohan looks to flick this one towards mid-wicket but does so uppishly. It goes straight to Baard at mid-wicket inside the circle who takes an easy catch. Singapore 36 for 4 after the end of 5 overs.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Rangarajan tries to have a slash at it but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Innovation at its peak! Rangarajan shuffles across the wickets and paddle scoops this one over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Rangarajan tries to cut but misses.
Wide! Bowls it wide outside off, but too wide for the umpire's liking. Wide signaled.
Rangarajan hits this one straight over the bowler's head. The ball lobs towards long on and the batters take two.
Length ball wide outside off, Rohan slaps it through the cover region. The fielder from inside the circle hares after it and keeps it down to two.
Shortish length on middle, tapped towards point for a single.
Swing and a miss! Length just outside off, Rangarajan swings hard but misses.
Length ball on middle, tucked towards mid on for a quick run.
Length ball around off, pushed towards backward point for a single.
Beaten! Good length ball around off, Rangarajan looks to push it off his back foot but misses to get any bat on the ball.
On the pads, worked towards square leg for an easy single.
Down the leg side, Rangarajan looks to paddle sweep this one but misses.

Another catch dropped! What is Namibia doing here? Another one wide outside off, this time David slashes at it and gets a top edge. The ball balloons over the cover fielder who is trying to run back and take the catch but puts it down. Should be taking those catches.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Wide! This time this is way outside off and a wide is signalled.
Another one outside off, Rangarajan looks to cut again but is beaten.
Length ball on off, Rangarajan looks to cut but misses.

DROPPED! This one was way wide outside off, David looks to chase this and gets a top edge on it as he looks to slash this one towards cover. It goes high in the sky, the fielder settles himself under it but puts down a dolly. The batters take one.
JJ Smit into the attack now.
On the pads, Tim flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Rangarajan plays that one off the front foot and onto the pitch. The batters take a quick single and Rohan is off the mark.
Rohan Rangarajan comes out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Singapore falling like nine-pins here! Length ball just outside off, Aritra Dutta looks to slog this one over mid on. However, this comes off the bottom half of the bat and the ball goes straight to JJ Smit at mid on. He takes an easy catch and Singapore lose their third wicket.
Length ball outside off, Dutta drives but misses.
Short ball around middle, David pulls it through mid-wicket The short mid-wicket fielder hares after the ball, dives and pulls the ball back in play.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Aritra Dutta is the new man in. Christi Viljoen to share the new ball from the other end.

OUT! He throws his wicket away now. Full ball outside off, Sunil skips down the track to loft it over the long on region but mistimes. The ball takes thick outside edge and flies high towards short third man region. Kotze takes a fine catch there to send Sunil packing.
SIX! Up and over! Fuller length ball outside off, Sunil reaches out and lofts it over the long off fence for a biggie. Top shot that one.
Length ball on middle, Sunil looks to tuck it on the leg side again but misses to get hit on the pads.

NOT OUT! A risky run that one. A better throw would have seen another batter gone for a golden duck. Length ball around off, Sunil pushes it towards cover and takes off for a run. He has been sent back. A better throw would've been curtain for Sunil.
Aryaman Sunil is the new man in.

OUT! Timber! A golden duck for Chandramohan. A good length ball around middle, Chandramohan looks to tuck it towards the leg side but the ball swings in sharply and demolishes the timber behind. What a start this is for Namibia.
Shortish length ball around off, David punches it towards point and takes for a quick single.

The Namibia players are back on the pitch. They are taking their fielding positions. The Singapore batters follow them and they will be looking to get off to a good start. Tim David and Surendran Chandramohan are at the crease. Jan Flylinck to start the proceedings with the ball.
